property_mappings.reasoning: Column event_date ('2026-03-11') records when the incident occurred, directly matching the Action property 'event start time'.
Column notes contains free-text narratives such as 'Armed clash reported in the port district of Gdansk.', which is exactly the 'action description' datatype of bsm:Action.
Column sub_event_type categorizes the incident ('Armed clash'), functioning as a classification of the action per the 'classification code' label.
Column source names the reporting origin ('Baltic Monitoring Desk'), aligning by name with the BattlespaceConcept 'source identifier' attribute.
Column actor1 holds the first belligerent ('Military Forces of Poland (2023-)'), matching the Action object property 'involved actor'.
Column actor2 holds the opposing participant ('Unidentified Armed Group (Baltic)'), likewise matching 'involved actor'.
Column assoc_actor_1 names an additional unit associated with actor1 ('Naval Command of Poland'), so it participates in the event as another involved actor.
Column assoc_actor_2 names an additional group associated with actor2, so when populated it is also an involved actor of the event.
Columns country/admin1/location state where the incident happened ('Poland', 'Pomorskie', 'Gdansk'), matching the BattlespaceConcept property 'has geographic location'.
The event's fatalities count has no direct Action attribute, so it is modeled as a bsm:ActionEffect (effect quantity) reached through the Action property 'has result'.

subject_mappings.reasoning: Columns country, admin1 and location form a place hierarchy ('Poland' / 'Pomorskie' / 'Gdansk') describing where the event occurred, matching bsm:Location.
